requirements.value: License by endorsement available if the division determines the out-of-state license encompasses a similar scope of practice, the applicant has at least one year of experience, and the license is in good standing.
requirements.quote: the division shall issue a license to an applicant who has been licensed in another state, district, or territory of the United States if: (a) the division determines that the license issued in the other state, district, or territory encompasses a similar scope of practice as the license sought in this state; (b) the applicant has at least one year of experience practicing under the license issued in the other state, district, or territory; and (c) the applicant's license is in good standing

definition_quote.value: "Practice of acupuncture" means the insertion of acupuncture needles, the use of injection therapy, and the application of moxibustion to specific areas of the body based on traditional oriental medical diagnosis and modern research as a primary mode of therapy.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of acupuncture" means the insertion of acupuncture needles, the use of injection therapy, and the application of moxibustion to specific areas of the body based on traditional oriental medical diagnosis and modern research as a primary mode of therapy.

value: manual, mechanical, thermal, electrical, light, and electromagnetic treatments
recommendation, administration, or provision of dietary guidelines, herbs, supplements, homeopathics, and therapeutic exercise
acupuncture on animals to the extent permitted by law
methods_authorized.quote: Adjunctive therapies within the scope of the practice of acupuncture may include: (i) manual, mechanical, thermal, electrical, light, and electromagnetic treatments based on traditional oriental medical diagnosis and modern research; (ii) the recommendation, administration, or provision of dietary guidelines, herbs, supplements, homeopathics, and therapeutic exercise based on traditional oriental medical diagnosis and modern research according to practitioner training; and (iii) the practice described in Subsections (5)(a) and (b) on an animal

drug_authority.value: A licensee with a clean needle technique certificate from NCCAOM has authority to procure and administer specified sterile substances for in-office injection therapy only.
drug_authority.quote: has authority to procure and administer prescriptive substances described in Subsections 58-72-102(2)(a) and (b) for in-office administration only

nccaom_certification_required.quote: meet the requirements for current active certification in acupuncture under guidelines established by the National Commission for the Certification of Acupuncture and Oriental Medicine (NCCAOM) as demonstrated through a current certificate or other appropriate documentation

clean_needle_technique_certificate_requi.quote: "Injection therapy" means the use of a hypodermic needle, by a licensed acupuncturist who has obtained a clean needle technique certificate from the National Commission for the Certification of Acupuncture and Oriental Medicine (NCCAOM)

injection_therapy_authorized.quote: "Injection therapy" means the use of a hypodermic needle, by a licensed acupuncturist who has obtained a clean needle technique certificate from the National Commission for the Certification of Acupuncture and Oriental Medicine (NCCAOM), to inject any of the following sterile substances in liquid form into acupuncture points on the body subcutaneously or intramuscularly

value: autologous blood, if the licensee holds a current phlebotomy certification to draw blood
injectable_substances_authorized.quote: to inject any of the following sterile substances in liquid form into acupuncture points on the body subcutaneously or intramuscularly: (i) a nutritional substance; (ii) a local anesthetic; (iii) autologous blood, if the licensee holds a current phlebotomy certification to draw blood; (iv) sterile water; (v) dextrose; (vi) sodium bicarbonate; and (vii) sterile saline.

injection_therapy_excluded_sites.quote: "Injection therapy" does not include injecting a substance into a vein, joint, artery, blood vessel, nerve, tendon, deep organ, or the spine.

value: child under the age of eight
injection_therapy_patient_exclusions.quote: "Injection therapy" may not be performed on a pregnant woman or a child under the age of eight.

adjunctive_therapies_authorized.quote: Adjunctive therapies within the scope of the practice of acupuncture may include: (i) manual, mechanical, thermal, electrical, light, and electromagnetic treatments based on traditional oriental medical diagnosis and modern research; (ii) the recommendation, administration, or provision of dietary guidelines, herbs, supplements, homeopathics, and therapeutic exercise based on traditional oriental medical diagnosis and modern research according to practitioner training; and (iii) the practice described in Subsections (5)(a) and (b) on an animal

dietary_and_herbal_recommendations_autho.quote: the recommendation, administration, or provision of dietary guidelines, herbs, supplements, homeopathics, and therapeutic exercise based on traditional oriental medical diagnosis and modern research according to practitioner training

animal_acupuncture_authorized.quote: the practice described in Subsections (5)(a) and (b) on an animal to the extent permitted by: (A) Subsection 58-28-307(12); (B) the provisions of this chapter; and (C) division rule.

moxibustion_authorized.quote: "Moxibustion" means a heat therapy that uses the herb moxa to heat acupuncture points of the body.

value: manual manipulation or adjustment of the joints of the body beyond the elastic barrier
manipulation of the articulation of the spinal column as defined in Section 58-73-102
scope_exclusions.quote: "Practice of acupuncture" does not include: (i) the manual manipulation or adjustment of the joints of the body beyond the elastic barrier; or (ii) the "manipulation of the articulation of the spinal column" as defined in Section 58-73-102.

value: individual described in Section 58-1-602 performing a procedure described in Section 58-1-602
physician and surgeon or osteopathic physician and surgeon licensed under Utah Medical Practice Act and Utah Osteopathic Medical Practice Act
commissioned physician or surgeon serving in the armed forces of the United States or other federal agency
chiropractic physician licensed under Chapter 73, Chiropractic Physician Practice Act
license_exempt_practitioner_types.quote: the following individuals may engage in the practice of acupuncture subject to the stated circumstances and limitations without being licensed under this chapter: (1) an individual described in Section 58-1-602 who is performing a procedure described in Section 58-1-602; (2) an individual licensed as a physician and surgeon or osteopathic physician and surgeon under Chapter 67, Utah Medical Practice Act, and Chapter 68, Utah Osteopathic Medical Practice Act; (3) a commissioned physician or surgeon serving in the armed forces of the United States or other federal agency; and (4) a chiropractic physician licensed under Chapter 73, Chiropractic Physician Practice Act

authorized_professional_title.quote: "Licensed acupuncturist," designated as "L.Ac.," means a person who has been licensed under this chapter to practice acupuncture.

prohibited_titles.quote: A licensed acupuncturist may not use the term "physician," "physician or surgeon," or "doctor" in conjunction with the acupuncturist's name or practice.
prohibited_titles.citation: Section 501 - Acupuncture licensee -- Restriction on titles used.

informed_consent_procedures_required.quote: establish procedures, as defined by rule, which shall enable patients to give informed consent to treatment
